name: FORGE trusted token probe LAB ONLY
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, reopened]
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: forge-drill-token-probe
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  permission_probe:
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'forge/owner/__RUN__/actions-trigger/M0/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 4
    permissions: {}
    env:
      PROBE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      EXPECTED_REPO: __REPO__
      WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Fixed trusted permission probe without checkout
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
__INLINE_PROBE__
          PY
  rule_probe:
    if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'forge/owner/__RUN__/actions-trigger/') && !contains(github.head_ref, '/actions-trigger/M0/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 4
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    env:
      PROBE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      EXPECTED_REPO: __REPO__
      WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Fixed trusted probe without checkout
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
__INLINE_PROBE__
          PY
